rows.en: Aurelie: "Oh..."
Touya: "Hey. There's something I'd like to ask."
Aurelie: "Yes... What?"
Touya: "You said before that you grew up in an orphanage.
I'd like to hear a little more about that."
Aurelie: "...I don't mind, but why?"
Touya: "Hmm. Maybe it was just my imagination,
but you looked sad too."
Aurelie: "Meddling again, as usual?"
Touya: "Maybe."
Aurelie: "...Come to think of it, Touya, your parents
passed away, didn't they?"
Touya: "Yeah... They were caught in a terrorist attack at an airport."
Aurelie: "Sometimes you only realize how important something is
after you lose it. But even if your parents are there,
that doesn't necessarily mean you'll be happy..."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Aurelie: "I'd always been told that my parents died
right after I was born. But that wasn't true.
I found out my mother was alive.
At first, I didn't want to see her.
Whatever her reasons, she was the person who abandoned me.
But... Before I knew it, I was heading to her house.
I wonder why. I was supposed to hate her, but
I couldn't help wanting to see her face.
...But I shouldn't have gone.
There was an ordinary, warm family there.
My mother, her husband, and one little boy..."
Aurelie: "That was when I realized.
There was no place for me there...
I had no right to destroy the happiness they had."
Yamato: "That's... That's awful, meow...
You're her daughter too, Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "No. In a way, I was at fault too.
When I saw my mother's face, I realized she was the person
who often brought me sweets when I was little.
She had told me she was an unmarried mother with a daughter,
but without realizing any of that, I told her how much
I hated my mother. That I didn't even want to see her face, that she made me sick.
She just smiled in silence, with such sad eyes..."
Touya: "But you're her own daughter, aren't you?
Whether you hated her or not shouldn't be the issue..."
Aurelie: "If she'd been that strong, she wouldn't have left me
in an orphanage."
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "Besides, I should be grateful just that she gave birth to me."
Touya: "Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Because otherwise,
I wouldn't have met you like this, Touya... Oh."
Touya: "?"
Aurelie: "N-No, it's nothing!"
Touya: "Then you don't hate her anymore?"
Aurelie: "...Well, yes.
I'd be lying if I said it didn't bother me.
But it was only after coming to Agarthia
that I started to see things this way.
Since coming here, I've had time to think about a lot of things."
Touya: "I see..."
Aurelie: "Sometimes, just watching over someone is the best relationship.
Everyone should get to be happy...
Oh, sorry. It isn't like me to get so gloomy."
Touya: "Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Oh, I've got something to do, so I'll be off! Bye!"
Yamato: "...Aurelie's had a hard time too, meow..."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Yamato: "But lately, Aurelie's expressions
have become softer than before, meow.
Could that be thanks to a certain someone?"
Touya: "...All right, shall we go too?"
Yamato: "Oh, you're embarrassed!"
Touya: "Shut up."
